sentences.en: An acute lack of funds is holding up the plan.
sentences.zh: 资金严重短缺导致计划受阻。

sentences.en: "How did it go?" "They said it was acute appendicitis."
sentences.zh: "进展如何？" "他们说那是急性阑尾炎。"

sentences.en: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
sentences.zh: 她敏锐的观察力使她非常适合成为一名摄影师。

senses.zh: 敏锐的：keen discernment; 严重的，急性的：immediate attention; （程度、影响）极强的：extreme
